notes.title: Chants of Sennaar OST vinyl is OUT!
notes.content:
Hey, travelers!✨

We're absolutely ecstatic to announce that Chants of Sennaar has reached the 10,000 Steam reviews stonemile while maintaining its Overwhelmingly Positive score of 98%! Thank you to all players for this wonderful reception, it truly warms our hearts. ❤️

To continue your journey throughout Chants of Sennaar’s enchanting universe, we’re glad to announce that the vinyl version of the game's OST is out now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286095/aa087749d55139009c8673bc37c17ec8e3c94682.png

notes.title: Steam Awards 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We hope you guys are doing well! We have some exciting news to share: we're participating in this year's Steam Awards!

Help us keep Chants of Sennaar's journey splendid!


Nominate Chants of Sennaar for the "Outstanding Visual Style" award 2023! Visual style doesn't aspire to real-world graphical fidelity (though a noble goal in itself)… it describes a distinctive look and feel that suffuses an entire game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286095/acfe0786f6832c89e5e76e6a9d4e7414dc512c73.jpg

Unveil mysteries behind the fragments of the past

Divided since the dawn of time, the Peoples of the Tower no longer speak to each other. But it is said that one day, a Traveler will find the wisdom to break down the walls and restore the Balance. Explore and discover an enthralling world in a colorful, poetic setting inspired by the myth of Babel, where men have forgotten their past. Travel the endless steps of a prodigious labyrinth, uncover an ominous truth and unveil the mysteries of this fascinating universe where ancient languages are both the lock and the key. 

Embark on a captivating journey with ancient languages to decipher


 Explore a beautiful, fascinating world with a strong narrative inspired by the myth of Babel
 Observe your environment and solve puzzles to unravel the mysteries around you
 Use stealth and cunning to outwit the Guardians and cross the forbidden zones
 Decipher ancient languages to restore the connections between the Peoples of the Tower

notes.title: Chants of Sennaar at The Game Awards 2023!
notes.content:
Hello, travelers!

We're so thrilled to announce that Chants of Sennaar has been nominated at The Game Awards 2023, an annual awards ceremony honoring achievements in the video game industry. We're incredibly thankful to be part of such an amazing event, among so many amazing games!

notes.title: A patch for your enchanted journey!
notes.content:
Hello, travelers!

We'd like to thank you for all your support since the release of Chants of Sennaar! 

To make your adventure even better, we're now releasing a patch to improve the game's fluidity, translations and a few bugs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286095/3333c87a26822186f1aab9669009c7e677bd0535.png

Translation:

- Modification of some translations on the bard-alchemist rosetta stone in the galleries.

Bug fix:

- Writing an @ in a rune annotation no longer causes save corruption
- The framerate is now limited to 540 FPS max, resolving certain issues.
 
Improvements:

- Esc can now be pressed to exit zoom views, dialogs, ghosts, processions, etc.
- The stairs in the silver mine are now made of iron, making them more visible.
- In the 2nd alchemists' lab, a graduated ruler with zoom view has been added.
- Radar can now be displayed by pressing left or right shift 
- New conditions to unlock the "I did it" achievement have been included.

notes.title: Discover Chants of Sennaar in a new Gameplay Overview Trailer!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're happy to unveil the Gameplay Overview Trailer for Chants of Sennaar! 

Pre-orders are open, with a free demo on all platforms to give you a first, mesmerizing impression of the immersive experience. Discover an invitation to openness and diversity with lots of mysteries to uncover, in today’s Gameplay Overview Trailer!

[previewyoutube=tSN6KhscgiE;full][/previewyoutube]

A fascinating world where ancient languages are both the lock and the key

In Chants of Sennaar, explore a fascinating universe inspired by the myth of Babel, and restore the links between Peoples. Immerse yourself in an enigmatic city home to a vast and mythical tower. 
Observe, listen, and decipher ancient languages. Solve enigmas and puzzles, play mini games, escape the scrutiny of the guards, and dodge the many traps in your way.

Guided by your notebook, translate each glyph you encounter by observing, exploring and talking to people. Use deduction to pave your way to the top of the Tower—a prodigious labyrinth full of mysteries to unveil.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286095/bbbde16592de55362eef7c64f41c0c4519eee328.jpg

Inspired by real languages, each dialect in Chants of Sennaar has its own rhythm, grammar, and syntax, for a compelling and fulfilling experience. 
Each People has a unique story to tell, encompassing folklore, culture, architectural styles, and their own technologies, making every level of the tower richly distinct. 

And ultimately forming an unforgettable journey, enriched by the audiovisual enchantment of a beautiful and colorful world inspired by European comic masterpieces and driven by a soul-stirring, lyrical soundtrack - that will be available for purchase on Steam at launch.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1931770/Chants_of_Sennaar/
